value.rationale: Exact signed cubic output-profile expectation distinguishes sparse, half-dense, and dense regular layers through a graph-independent sign reversal, despite identical nonnegative quadratic mixing behavior at the phase point. The nonclosure witness at fourth order explains why a one-factor higher-power generalization fails. This is a motivated structural addition to a contemporaneous random-kernel product model, not a mere reparameterization of its known chi-square law.
